description: Create exactly one canonical Taminyaran Customer Hub case after the user explicitly requests it. This is a public-intake write: confirm_create must be true, phone/display_name/title are required, and idempotency_key prevents duplicate Case creation. The owner may resolve an existing Customer by normalized mobile or create a new Customer; Customer access credentials are never returned to the Agent. The response includes public Case/Project refs plus a short-lived thread_token for subsequent conversation tools. thread_token is sensitive and must remain in POST bodies only.
name: case_create
